## Plan
1. `hh-monitor/src/wire.rs` — `AuthorizeInput` canonical codec
   (handles, Π, proposers, capabilities, approval fold, proposal).
2. `crates/hh-monitor/src/bin/hh-authorize.rs` — decode →
   `Monitor::authorize` → canonical `KernelDecision` stdout.
3. Conformance test: in-process vs spawned-binary byte equality;
   model-profile flip invariance; changed-input distinguishability.
4. `respond_permission` → `mint_approval_handle` → `granted` row
   (atomic with `decided`+`lease.granted`); `open_session` →
   `mint_root_handles`/`mint_preauthorization_handles` → `granted`
   rows (H-7: run expiry).
5. `granted_payload` gains `permission_id` member on
   `origin_basis = approval` rows (GRANT_FIELDS already declares it).
6. HIR `ops.rs`/`validate.rs` audit for the new rule actions.
7. Deferrals/ADRs/ledger close-out.

## Gap table
| gap | disposition |
|---|---|
| `batch_id` was parsed/folded but never minted | **closed** — `mint_batch_id` (ADR-0268 D2) wired at the dispatch ask site, gated on `EscalationInput.batchable` |
| `attestation_ref` was carried but never gated admission | **closed** — unattested `HookReport`s skipped in `run_chain` (ADR-0268 D3) + removal-sensitive test |
| `authority_cap` rows stored on `SessionState` but unused | **closed** — `respond_permission` folds `min(grant_authority, caps)` into `ApprovalMint.ceiling`; `of` binds the capability semantic id (ADR-0268 D5) |
| pre-auth mint hardcoded `ceiling = delegate`, no caps | **closed** — `min(definition, issuer.authority, caps)` per §5g.1 "issued at definition; bounded by authority_cap" (ADR-0268 D4) |
| `resume`/fork paths dropped `authority_caps` | **closed** — re-derived from the persisted sealed definition via `harness_def_ref` (`open.rs`/`work.rs`) |
| `label.endorsed{basis:approval}` emission, `ApproverGrant`, `modify` | **stays deferred** — C1/C2 per DF-S1.23-1's own staging |
| egress ask-endorsement ingress (DF-S2.4-1b) | **stays open** — no parked asks exist until the `net_egress` call site (tool-effect ticket) lands; wiring `endorse_asked` now would be a dead seam |
